result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there are a few minor visual issues related to horizontal overflow and the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The category chip row is horizontally clipped on the right, with only part of the next chip visible.
issues.suggestion: Add intentional horizontal scrolling behavior with clearer edge spacing or a subtle scroll cue, and ensure the partially visible chip does not look accidentally cut off.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” carousel cuts off the third restaurant card at the right edge, including its name.
issues.suggestion: Preserve the carousel peek if intentional but add consistent right padding and scrolling affordance; otherwise constrain cards so they fit cleanly within the viewport.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower restaurant card, obscuring its content and making the page appear cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the navigation bar height plus safe-area spacing so cards can be fully viewed above the fixed navigation.
